notes.title: Winter Wastelands 1.1.3 Update is out!
notes.notes:
The Winter Wastelands 1.1.3 Update came out on February 22, 2022, and the game has been free (no longer $4.99) since February 27, 2022. Below are some of the features included in this update and a link to a previous community announcement post explaining the game's price change. Thank you!

Features:
1. After 3 seconds, the stamina bar reloads
2. Increased invincibility frames
3. Made The Knight's sword destructible to crystal projectiles
4. Made vines easier (only in easy-mode)

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1380490/announcements/detail/3112553992712037083

notes.title: 1.1 Update Adds Easy Mode
notes.notes: The Winter Wastelands 1.1 Update adds an easy mode to the game. Easy mode puts a smaller emphasis on combat and exploration in order for more people to play the game in its entirety. However, there will still be the normal mode in order for players to play the game how it was initially released. Enjoy!
